verdict.rationale: Once deployed to a phone number, Retell agents handle calls on their own and take real actions such as booking, SMS, transfers and external API calls (retell-docs-32, retell-docs-5, retell-docs-66). The platform also pushes call_started, call_ended and call_analyzed events through webhooks for downstream automation (retell-docs-52, retell-docs-24), and runs some background processes automatically: AI QA evaluation of sampled calls and per-agent retention deletion (retell-docs-43, retell-docs-27). However, everything is call-triggered, and the Conductor assistant only proposes changes for human review rather than acting on its own (retell-docs-53). missing for 10: scheduled or cron-style automations, outbound batch campaign triggers, a general background workflow builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended operation.
